kind: bounded glyph host diagnostic; corrected solid-arrow topology has more output triangles
candidate: streamed validity-aware glyph source identified by source_sha256
retained (probe expectation flag for 34 corrected triangles)
features.allocations: separate feature enables global allocator instrumentation

methodology: Four allocator-disabled release processes/version, ABBA twice; warmup plus five samples per case. Identical probe source at 128/1024/4096 unmasked point-cloud samples, stride 1. Validation, counts, derived magnitudes and first-arrow edge closure are checked outside timing; output destruction is excluded. Baseline solid arrows have 24 triangles and boundary edges; candidate has 34 triangles and closed edges. Both have 19 vertices. Tensor glyphs retain 26 vertices/48 triangles and line arrows retain four vertices/three segments. Candidate validates input while baseline skips it. Separate allocation runs supply allocated bytes, not peak RSS. No controlled affinity/thermal/energy or physical mobile qualification.
